# proxmox_node_sdn (Data Source)

Lists SDN sections available on a node from `/nodes/{node}/sdn`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_node_sdn" "s" { node = "pve-1" }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String)

### Read-Only

- `sections` (List of String)
